description: Sharing to Posit Connect: the markup the browser script reads, the titles and footer a shared copy carries, and the static bundle's manifest. The source is tests/shared/share.json; the copy under pkg-r/tests/testthat/fixtures/shared/ is generated by scripts/sync-shared.sh. Edit the source and re-run that script.

markup.description: commons-share.js ships with both packages and reads this markup. A server that emits anything else gets no share buttons and no error.

wrap.description: A plot or table in a tool's display, wrapped so the browser can offer to share it and the server can find it again in the turns. `{id}` is a fresh id matching `id_pattern`. The script reads `script_reads` from the wrapper; the comments and title are for the server.

cases.name: a titled figure, its title escaped
cases.title: Sightings & counts

controls.description: Elements the server renders and the script finds by class, with the attributes it reads from each.

connect.description: Connect requires a title of 3 to 1024 characters without line breaks. `repeat` builds a long input.

fallback.description: A conversation or output without a title of its own is named for the app.

clean.description: A plot's or table's own title, made fit for a page heading. null means it has none.

truncate.description: A question used as a title is cut to `max_chars`, ending in an ellipsis.

cases.input: Which regions had the most bird sightings this spring, and how does that compare to fall?
cases.expected: Which regions had the most bird sightings this spring, and how does that compar…

footer.description: The line closing every shared page. The date is written in English whatever the locale.

cases.name: an untitled app without a link
cases.expected: <footer class="commons-share-footer">Shared November 9, 2026 from a data agent. Results reflect the data as of that date.</footer>

cases.name: an untitled app with a link
cases.expected: Shared January 1, 2026 from a data agent. Results reflect the data as of that date.

cases.name: a titled app
cases.expected: Shared November 9, 2026 from the Biodiversity explorer agent. Results reflect the data as of that date.

cases.name: a title already ending in agent
cases.expected: <footer class="commons-share-footer">Shared November 9, 2026 from the Sales Agent. Results reflect the data as of that date.</footer>

cases.name: a title is escaped
cases.expected: <footer class="commons-share-footer">Shared November 9, 2026 from the R&D agent. Results reflect the data as of that date.</footer>

manifest.description: The manifest.json a static bundle carries: every other file in it, by path relative to the bundle, with its md5 checksum.
